meta.title: CTFPilot CTF solving tool
meta.description: Local dual-channel CTF solving engine: a deterministic fast path solves encoding chains, classical ciphers, XOR, archives and PNG LSB stego in seconds; misses fall through to the deep strategy loop. Includes experience recall, writeup learning and stats. Before recording a flag the model proposes a submit that the user confirms via a card under the answer; only confirmed flags reach the engine ledger — nothing is recorded without human confirmation. Tool entry: /ctfpilot; the sidebar icon opens the main-column dashboard panel.
